# Verify Security Finding

Separate the lead from the claim. Require target, prerequisites, attacker-controlled input, action path, observed security impact, reproducible steps, provenance, and meaningful negative or alternate-identity control evidence. Scanner matches, HTTP status, code patterns, and model assertions cannot prove a finding alone. Retain incomplete cases as leads with explicit gaps.
